profile.overview: Selesnya Conclave is the white-green Ravnican guild where communal voice, nature, unity, togetherness, and preservation overlap.
profile.philosophy: Belonging becomes sacred when individual voice joins a greater living community.
profile.core_tension: Selesnya offers harmony, care, and shared purpose while asking individual voice to yield to the communal one.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Selesnya as a collectivist nature-centered guild led through Mat'Selesnya and Trostani in the cited era, with the capacity to field a large army.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Convoke is Selesnya mechanics texture; creatures working together can support the guild theme, but tokens, populate, lifegain, counters, ramp, or go-wide gameplay do not prove Selesnya identity alone.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: Gate 3 remediation uses existing listed/local official source records only; discovery-story corpus rows remain search metadata until bounded source localization is performed.
Commander/card/product guidance is auxiliary and cannot prove Selesnya identity, placement, key figures, recruiter guidance, semantic readiness, public copy, or provenance chains.
